subject: Psychology
central_question: How do trained therapists use different psychological approaches, a therapeutic relationship and rehabilitation to reduce distress and improve functioning?

known_pitfalls.claim: Any sympathetic friend can practise psychotherapy.
known_pitfalls.correction: Psychotherapy requires systematic principles and supervised professional training.

known_pitfalls.claim: Symptom reduction always restores full functioning.
known_pitfalls.correction: Severe disorders may require rehabilitation after active symptoms decline.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Box 5.1: formulate a client problem.
NCERT Activity 5.3 and Box 5.2: connect breathing and relaxation.
NCERT Review Questions 6–9: integrate healing, alternatives, rehabilitation and CBT.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter Review Questions contain Questions 1–9, followed by two Project Ideas.
